content: Go CLI/TUI apps use cmd/<binary>/main.go for entry points and internal/ for all app logic. Key layout: cmd/alturd/main.go, internal/git/, internal/diff/, internal/ui/, internal/config/. The internal/ directory prevents external imports by compiler enforcement. Avoid pkg/ for self-contained binaries. Organize by domain (git, diff, ui) not technical layer. Avoid import cycles by keeping dependency direction: git/config have no internal deps, diff may import config, ui imports everything, main.go wires.
